decisions.reason: The XL anamnesis package remains a close modular extension of the core software for larger practices, so in a growing and increasingly digital dental-IT market it is likely to stay in the portfolio.

A support service for dental assistants fits the firm's service-heavy model, although it still carries some chance of being absorbed into broader support and training rather than maintained as a distinct product.
The materials management module strengthens the practice-efficiency value proposition and complements the established suite, making withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.
Secure healthcare messaging is closely tied to regulatory and telematics requirements, so it is strategically important and unlikely to be taken off the market soon after launch.
